page.overview:
Who is Carmen Zapata?

Carmen Zapata is a fictional Mexican intelligence operative. The character appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage.

Although she has been passed over for promotion twice, Carmen continues to work harder than any other agent towards the goals she has set for herself. A combination of optimism and stubbornness makes working with her either as good or as bad, as it can get. A single mother, she has skills in operations, surveillance and interrogation, and is multi-lingual, speaking Spanish, French, Russian and English. The character offers a buff which reduces facility costs and provides a 5% damage increase during Conflict and Villain fights using razor wire, along with a +6 stamina bonus using medical kits. She is a "common agent" (white) and can be levelled to level 5.
